changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.v_player_records AS SELECT mp.player_id, m.match_type, p.display_name, p.province, p.city, p.barangay, p.avatar_path, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.result_status = 'won')::int AS wins, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.result_status = 'lost')::int AS losses, count(*)::int AS matches_played, round( count(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.result_status = 'won')::numeric / count(*)::numeric * 100, 1 ) AS win_pct FROM match_participants mp JOIN matches m ON m.id = mp.match_id JOIN player_profiles p ON p.id = mp.player_id WHERE m.status = 'verified' AND mp.result_status IN ('won', 'lost') AND p.profile_visibility = 'public' GROUP BY mp.player_id, m.match_type, p.display_name, p.province, p.city, p.barangay, p.avatar_path;
GRANT SELECT ON public.v_player_records TO anon, authenticated;
